description: The Energy by municipality package describes well counts, oil and gas production, and remaining gas reserves. Its metadata covers 2003–2014 and lists a CSV distribution. These are physical energy-asset and production observations aggregated by municipality. The description does not identify well-status classes, production units, reserve estimation methods or within-year sampling frequency. It does not establish current production or a numerical reservoir model. The municipal geography and limited variable list are preserved without adding unsupported fields. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue supplies the original Alberta identifiers and distribution descriptions. The source names Open Government Licence - Alberta. Costs and present file access remain unverified. This record covers inspected descriptive metadata; no dataset, document, archive or linked resource body was fetched. Specific simulation uses are unstated unless described above. Unlisted fields and numerical values remain unknown. Two named Alberta Regional Dashboard companions provide annual remaining natural-gas reserves and conventional/non-conventional oil production by municipal district. The oil definition includes unprocessed bitumen and synthetic oil. Native coverage is 2003–2021 for both. The reserves descriptors label CSV, XLSX, JSON and XML; the oil descriptors use URI formats while their labels name those same representations, so the format claim rests on the labels and has not been tested. These are curated companions to Energy by municipality with distinct variable definitions and longer native coverage; row-level or numerical equivalence is not asserted. The separate natural-gas production package is already represented by existing source records and is not duplicated in this expansion.
